subject: Material selection for reliable manufacture
hook: Cutting list in, labelled parts out. Here's the bit in between.
ig:
Cutting list in, labelled parts out. Here's the bit in between.

A quick look at how a trade order moves through our Hanley workshop:

— Sliding table panel saw: sheets cut to the sizes on your list
— Edge bander: ABS applied to the edges you've specified, in 0.4, 1 or 2 mm
— Multi-spindle boring machine: hinge cups, shelf-pin rows and dowel holes, if you need them
— Labelled part by part, so your fitter isn't playing a jigsaw on site
— Ready for workshop collection, or delivery quoted per job

You can stop at any stage: cut only, cut and edge, or go all the way to assembled cabinets.

Comment PANELS and we'll send you the link to our panel cutting page.
fb:
If you've ever wondered what happens to a cutting list once it lands with us, this is it.

Sheets go through the sliding table panel saw, edges are sealed on the edge bander, the boring machine handles hinge cups and shelf-pin rows where needed, and every part is labelled before it's ready for collection or delivery.

Cut only, cut and edge, drilled, or fully assembled — it's up to you. Find out more about our panel cutting service below.
